input.title: Token Factory watch · Tue Oct 27
input.content:
# Token Factory watch · Tue Oct 27

**One price changed for a role we use.** Nemotron 3 Super (Researcher, Analyst, Writer) goes from $0.30 / $0.90 to **$0.24 / $0.72** per 1M tokens on Oct 29. Ultra and Nano are unchanged; no model was added or removed.

## What it does to our week

| | week's cost | change |
|---|---|---|
| at today's prices | $0.0619 | |
| at the Oct 29 prices | $0.0581 | −6.1 % |
| plus the proposed rule | $0.0439 | −29.2 % in all |

## Proposed router rule

Keep the Orchestrator's **plan** turn on Ultra and run its later turns (spawn, handoff, approval, final judgment) on Super. The usage export has 5 Orchestrator hops; all but the first of each workstream would move.

*If applied: −29.2 %.* This is an estimate from one week of mock-model usage. It also trades some judgment on the final summary for cost: run `pnpm eval:ab --cheap` before and after.

Approving records the rule in `data/router-rules.json` so the saving can be tracked. The router does not read that file yet: applying it is a code change.
